items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 7 numbered items built with tests tagged FR-01.10; item 2 is single-use within 30 minutes per 'allows the next commit ... for 30 minutes'; docs rows + detail note updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable override log -> no override; unwritable CONSUMED line -> visible WARN; a commit target that is not a directory -> WARN + default root; malformed log lines skipped.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Override reasons are stripped of control characters before echo; the printf instruction passes the reason as a separate %s argument; future-dated entries ignored so an override cannot be pre-dated.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real temp git repos for -C / --work-tree / --git-dir (negative probe: disabling the GIT_DIR hand-off fails the bare git-dir test); bash round-trip of the printed instruction; single-use proven by a second blocked run.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra small file read on a blocked command only; the commit parser lexes the command once more for other_targets - negligible next to the git subprocesses.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Three focused new lib modules (heredoc, commit target, override) instead of growing the hook; every touched file under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: compliance_overrides.log: producers = agent printf line and override_logger, consumer = compliance_override; round-trip probed (bash printf -> reader; CONSUMED write -> reader). compute_coverage output consumer is only rtm_gate_support (grep).
